info.name: GPS Backend - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for GPS Backend (Gyanoday Public School)

**Base URL:** https://gps-backend-p91d.onrender.com

**Authentication:**
- Uses Supabase JWT token authentication
- Token expires after 30 minutes
- Login automatically saves access_token and refresh_token
- All protected APIs require Authorization header: Bearer {{access_token}}

**Public APIs:**
- GET /api/results - Get student result (no auth required)
- GET /api/marks/result - Get student result (no auth required)

**Protected APIs:**
- All other APIs require authentication
- Admin only: Fees, Bills, Invoice, Subject management, User management, Fee Structure, Migration, Promotion
- Admin & Teacher: Students, Marks, Subjects (read), Invoice download

**Important Notes:**
- Student Leave API: PATCH /api/students/:id/leave - Marks student as inactive
- Student Rejoin API: PATCH /api/students/:id/rejoin - Reactivates student
- Bill Generation: Only generates bills for active students
- Fee Structure: Must be created before bill generation
